name: Burgui / Burgi (Spain)
description: Square flag with a red saltire over a field of white, yellow, blue and green triangles within a chevronny border, charged at the centre with the arms of Burgui and the Roncal valley.
history: Municipal flag of Burgui/Burgi; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
